title: Short homology bases for translation surfaces
summary: Let $S$ be a closed translation surface of genus $g\ge 2$ with $\mathop{area}(S)= 4πg$. We show that for any $λ\in (0, 1)$ there exist $\lfloor λ\cdot g\rfloor$ homologically independent simple closed curves of length at most $ C(λ) \cdot \log(g)$, where $C(λ)$ is a constant that depends only on $λ$. This result is obtained from a mixed graph construction based on a Voronoi graph of the surface with the cone points as seeds and its dual graph.
